patterns.example: 'It's not X, it's Y' / 'most do X, we do Y'
patterns.instead: We help good people do more with AI.
The fact that earns it: 741 people, 347 organizations.

patterns.example: 'solutions,' 'the future of work,' 'the intersection of innovation and impact'
'In an age of AI...', 'Imagine a world where...'
patterns.instead: AI is rewriting every industry, but it wasn't built for everyone.
The three returns: ROI, return on time, decision velocity.

patterns.example: 'in the same room,' 'move the needle,' 'take it to the next level'
patterns.instead: A 90-day path from first audit to running it on your own.
Every time AI touches your work, we tell you where, why, and how.

patterns.example: 'human in the loop,' the latest technical term
patterns.instead: AI is a sharp junior employee with no common sense.

patterns.example: a snappy tagline invented to sound good
patterns.instead: A real line from the source: 'We built our whole company with AI, and none of us were developers.'

tone_rules.name: Accessible and professional
tone_rules.rule: Plain is the goal, but not at the cost of credibility.

tone_rules.name: Radical AI transparency
tone_rules.rule: Always say when we are using AI, and why and how.

tone_rules.name: Accuracy tolerance
tone_rules.rule: Brand and marketing copy right about 90% is fine to refine. Financial, CRM, and data claims must be exact.

tone_rules.name: Real people, not AI images
tone_rules.rule: Show actual photographs of people building, over AI-generated graphics.
